=={{header|Cxc}}==

Only perfect squares stay open: a door at position d is toggled once per divisor of d, and squares have an odd number of divisors because the square root pairs with itself.

<syntaxhighlight lang="elixir">
def main:
    use console: Console
    -> running
        self :> step(1)

    running <: step(i: Int):
        |:  i > 10 -> end
        |?: -> running
            console.write("door " + (i * i).to_string() + " open")
            self :> step(i + 1)
</syntaxhighlight>
